test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

Agnes composed a song for her father’s birthday.

options.text: A song was composed by Agnes for her father’s birthday.
A song would have been composed by Agnes for her father’s birthday.
A song was being composed by Agnes for her father’s birthday.
A song had been composed by Agnes for her father’s birthday.

solution:
The correct answer is **'A song was composed by Agnes for her father’s birthday.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice** and expresses an action done by the subject.
 
• The sentence is in the **simple past tense**, indicated by the verb** "composed"**.
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"Agnes"**, and the object of the sentence is **"a song"**.
 
• **Active Format: **
 
 
• **Subject + V2 (past form of the verb) + Object.**
 
 
 
• **Passive Format: **
 
 
• **Subject (Objective case) + was/were + V3 (past participle) + by + Object (Subjective case).**
 
 
 
• An example in short is: "The teacher praised the student" becomes "The student was praised by the teacher" when changed to passive voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***"A song was composed by Agnes for her father’s birthday."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When changing from active to passive voice (or vice versa):
 
 
• The tense of the sentence should not be changed.
 
• Only the structure is altered to shift focus between the doer and the receiver of the action.
